integrity: Finite exhaustive and enumeration tests are corroboration only. Mathematical proof is presented for all parameter values. Classical scalar optimum is not asserted to be new.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three labelled partite classes of sizes 2<=a<=b<=c, and atomic optimum-preserving batch moves only. Known triangle-cover parametrizations already imply minimum-cover families, which are used as input rather than independently claimed as new. Historical priority of the batch exchange result remains provisional, particularly due to inaccessible full 2012 paper; no independent validation.
title: Sharp batch-exchange thresholds and glued-cube geometry for minimum triangle transversals
